title: India-US trade pact in last leg of legal drafting, says Piyush Goyal
summary: India is currently in the final stages of legal drafting for a trade agreement with the US, which is expected to be operational soon. The agreement, following sessions with US trade representatives, aims to ensure preferential access for Indian exporters. Indian officials hope for tariff stability and seek resolution on outstanding issues before the deal is signed.
